subject: [PATCH v9 29/32] mm: don't PTE-batch a swap-in over a hardware-poisoned subpage

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch prevents a swap-in operation from being batched over a hardware-poisoned subpage in the Linux kernel. The problem it solves is that the existing batching path does not check for poisoned subpages, allowing a potentially faulty page to be mapped and causing issues. To address this, the patch checks each subpage individually before mapping the rest of the folio, ensuring that any poisoned pages are properly reported and handled.
